title: First and third moments of a sign linear form
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every real coefficient vector $a=(a_i)_{i=0}^{n-1}$, let $L_a(x)=\\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}a_i x_i$ on the uniformly distributed sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. Both its mean and its third moment vanish: $\\mathbb E[L_a(x)]=0$ and $\\mathbb E[L_a(x)^3]=0$.
hypotheses_covered: An arbitrary real coefficient vector $a:\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}\\to\\mathbb R$
